description: Renouvellement du parc d'autobus de la régie de Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération. La régie de Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération a procédé au renouvellement de 2 bus en 2020 GNV dans un effort de verdissement de la flotte du parc en véhicules à faible émission. Coverage: Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération. The publisher named on the listing is Dracénie Provence Verdon agglomération. Its keywords include gnv, autobus, emission. The listing shows 1 download or service links in CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
